label: Google Sheets: Update Row
description: Overwrites one row of a Google Sheets tab, addressed by row number (from Append, Lookup or the New Row trigger) or an A1 range, with an object keyed by header names or a list of cells.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs write access to the sheet; the picker grant covers the file it picked.

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=
inputs.description: The tab to use. Empty: the first tab, whatever its id.

inputs.name: row
inputs.description: An object keyed by header column names, or a list of cells in order.

inputs.name: rowNumber
inputs.label: Row number
inputs.description: 1-based sheet row (exactly one of rowNumber / range).

inputs.name: range
inputs.label: Range
inputs.description: A1 range inside the tab (exactly one of rowNumber / range).

inputs.name: hasHeader
inputs.label: First row is a header
inputs.description: Needed to order an object row's columns.

then.message: GoogleSheetsUpdate '{id}' has both `rowNumber` and `range`. Keep `rowNumber` to write one row, or `range` to write at an A1 address, and remove the other.
